notes: Merged accounts now always add up their balances, even if you merged in an older version
Promo and cashback messages (like Ola Money credits) are no longer counted as money received
The Ledger now shows the whole month and scrolls all the way to the last entry
The Undo bar now disappears on its own after a few seconds
Update alerts arrive faster and work even when github.io is blocked
Credit cards no longer count as balance, and card bill payments are not counted as spending
New privacy, cookie, security, data deletion and open-source licence pages
